labelPriority: Other visible systems in ordinal ID order

route.ownership: Frontend presentation-only extraction of exact shared boundary endpoints from existing detached polygons; doubled midpoint coordinates, no new portable DTO

corridors.quietDefault: Breathing room with neutral boundaries; no invented stars or ownership fill
corridors.disturbedEmpty: Real feature cues may remain in small empty regions
corridors.authority: Only actual declared quiet/disturbed classification and connected-component memberships; summary-only fallback if no geometry exists
corridors.areaRatio: Generation diagnostic, never a rendering scale factor

resourceLimits: CPU/source/browser only; no Unity/native/GPU/input or paid generation; obey included-usage stop policy
